description: Container with runAsNonRoot: false and runAsUser: 0
note: CIS Kubernetes 5.2.7. Trivy splits this: KSV-0105 is the explicit runAsUser: 0, where KSV-0012 (runs as root user) is the *absent* securityContext -- that one belongs to k8s-no-security-context. Also raises KSV-0020 and CKV_K8S_40 (UID <= 10000), which are stricter than the benchmark asks and are deliberately unmapped.
